description: Earthshatter Spaulders Level 60 Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Earthshatter Spaulders if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Spaulders, 12 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 2 Arcanite Bars and 2 Mooncloth. Requirements: - Desecrated Spaulders - Wartorn Chain Scrap x 12 - Arcanite Bar x 2 - Mooncloth x 2
